catharanthus_gene_identifier_rule: Use the frozen exact H5AD-gene to locus-tag table where present; otherwise normalize the assembly-matched M9H77 identifier by replacing '-' with '_' and require an exact match to the frozen longest-protein FASTA.
reason: SAMap consumes exact protein identifiers rather than frozen Phase 12 orthogroup identifiers. The assembly and longest-protein FASTA remain the previously frozen GCA_024505715.1 assets.
